changelog: Your agent can no longer send wording you have not seen, and /vibe stops repeating itself.
features: A draft can be sent only after you have had a turn to see it. If you say "send it, but add this", your agent shows you the new wording first
A message you have already answered is no longer listed as waiting, and an arrival is announced once, not twice
Before your agent tells you someone has not replied, it reads the conversation
When someone you do not know yet writes, /vibe reminds you it may be a person you invited
